mapping_note: Direct mappings cover the registration-success result (4.15), announcement label/tag (4.16), and Federation Synchronized completion/failure-set callback (4.18.2). Disable/enable suppression and release and the callback servicing choice are tested as supplemental public-API behavior; no synchronization-specific direct candidate for those assertions is claimed.
notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard synchronization-point registration, announcement, and completion callbacks. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies callback suppression and release, standard label and tag metadata, successful FederationSynchronized completion, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
